python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
cs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
rs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(cs)==len(rs)==56
assert [c['card_id'] for c in cs]==[r['card_id'] for r in rs]
assert len({r['card_id'] for r in rs})==len(rs)
for r in rs:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where']).issubset(r)
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert set(r['owner_crop'])==set(['one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'])
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(w)=={'label','printed'} for w in r['where'])
print('Count and order verified:',len(rs))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in rs)))
print('Errors',collections.Counter(e for r in rs for e in r['errors']).most_common())
